metadata.title: Manimuni, Tengesi aru Mas | Assamese Style Fish Currry
metadata.description:
Manimuni or asiatic pennywort as they're known in English and Tengesi a.k.a Indian sorrel are plants with medicinal properties which grows in abundance in the NE states. 

This dish captures the rustic nature of cooking in villages where locally available herbs are used to bring out more flavors.

Learn how to cook fish with Asiatic Pennywort and Indian sorrel Assamese style.
